title: Xanthe and the Protocol
author: Edmund Crane
blurb: Casper Nystrom, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
